-- Boeing, Boeing
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Boeing, Boeing' AND t.name IN ('French Comedy', 'College Theatre')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Barefoot in the Park
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)

WHERE p.title = 'Barefoot in the Park' AND t.name IN ('Neil Simon')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
